Class JayLexi

All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IAdvancedRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents2, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicEvents3, robocode.robotinterfaces.IBasicRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IInteractiveRobot, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintEvents, robocode.robotinterfaces.IPaintRobot
public class JayLexi extends robocode.AdvancedRobot
JayLexi, a MiniRumble 1v1 robot (docs/kitlab.md): a true wave surfer that weighs back and forward with precise prediction on the two nearest waves and flees straight away while no wave is in flight, over a GuessFactor gun segmented on velocity history, lateral velocity, walls and distance. One wave class serves the gun and the surfing. The code is written tight to stay under the 1,500 byte MiniRumble limit (docs/bench/kitlab-0.2-arms.md). Ideas taken, with thanks, from open RoboWiki bots: Komarious (Voidious, RWPCL) for the mini precise prediction, the danger weighting and the gun's segments; RaikoMicro (Jamougha) for the gun; PEZ's iterative wall smoothing; Iiley's back-as-front drive. The code is JayLexi's own and ships with its source.
